Realistic human prose, language/gold review, fresh test allocation, final model eligibility and budget remain pending.

semantic_review.diagnostic: Every added release/deadline is entailed by the unchanged activity availability windows; no gold constraint is missing. A representation mismatch, not a demonstrated feasible-set change. Historical structural score retained.
